prompt: What will the record show without an update?
promptZh: 預約紀錄如果沒更新，會顯示什麼？

options.text: Both slots assigned to the man
options.zh: 兩個時段都登記在男方名下
options.whyZh: 互換前男方只訂了星期日下午。

options.text: Saturday still assigned to the woman
options.zh: 星期六仍登記在女方名下
options.whyZh: 女方原訂星期六；沒請服務台更新，就不會反映交換後的安排。

options.text: Both weekend slots marked as cancelled
options.zh: 週末兩個時段都標為取消
options.whyZh: 互換不是取消，原紀錄也沒取消。

options.text: Sunday shown as still open to anyone
options.zh: 星期日顯示為開放預約
options.whyZh: 星期日是男方原先的預約；兩人私下互換不會改變原紀錄。

explanationZh: 女方原訂星期六；沒請服務台更新，就不會反映交換後的安排。
evidence: I booked the dehydrator for Saturday morning, but my pears aren’t ripe. Still using it Sunday afternoon? / Yes. My apple slices are ready. I could take Saturday if you take Sunday. / I will. Let’s tell the kitchen desk today so they update the bookings before the weekend.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I booked the dehydrator for Saturday morning, but my pears aren’t ripe. Still using it Sunday afternoon?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Yes. My apple slices are ready. I could take Saturday if you take Sunday.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
